result.rationale: In the new handler apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts, the diff shows `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` with no safeParse or try/catch, so a malformed body throws an unhandled ZodError (500). Similarly `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...))` is unguarded, so bad ciphertext or key mismatch throws raw 500s. The mechanism described is accurate and verifiable in the diff, though impact is limited (endpoint already gated by secret checks) — hence moderate confidence.
